name: PU1251013 (Hubble)
blurb: PU1251013, an ultra-diffuse galaxy in the Coma region, seen by Hubble.
label: pu1251013-hubble
story: PU1251013 is one of the extreme, extended ultra-diffuse galaxies found in the Coma region: faint and sprawling, with few stars for its size. Hubble counted the globular star clusters scattered around it, to test whether these ancient clusters form before the galaxy itself.

claims.text: PU1251013 is one of the extreme (largest) ultra-diffuse galaxies in the Coma region
The program counts globular clusters to test whether globular cluster formation precedes formation of the central galaxy
Ultra-diffuse galaxies like DF44 have few stars relative to their globular clusters
